thread:
maria: FYI — customer C-827 raised that their SIEM shows a gap of audit events between 2026-02-10T03:00Z and 2026-02-10T04:00Z. They say the forwarder received no events for that window.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-4278 · channel #eng-security · priority P2
sam: Do we have any deploys/rotations around that timeframe? KMS rotations or forwarder changes?
jordan: I rotated the primary KMS key for audit-export on 2026-02-10 at ~02:57Z (can share rotation id). Did we re-roll the forwarder role policy?
maria: Rotation ID: kr-0a9f3c2d. Customer timeline shows missing events starting ~03:00Z. They forwarded screenshots of their SIEM showing an abrupt stop.
eli: Can someone paste the forwarder logs for that time window? looking for decrypt errors or 403s.
maria: here's the tail from forwarder-3 (UTC timestamps):
```
2026-02-10T02:58:21Z INFO  audit-forwarder starting key rotation check
2026-02-10T02:59:03Z WARN  decrypt failed for s3://audit-archive/C-827/2026/02/10/03/part-0001.json.gz - AccessDeniedException: kms:Decrypt denied for key kr-0a9f3c2d
2026-02-10T03:00:01Z ERROR send_to_siem failed batch=3 err=failed to decrypt payload
2026-02-10T03:15:27Z INFO  exporter paused for customer C-827 - requeueing
```

sam: That decrypt denied looks like the forwarder's IAM role lost kms:Decrypt permissions on the new key. Did the rotation replace key with a different key id and we forgot to patch the role?
jordan: The rotation switched to an alternate key alias, but I did run the automation that should copy grants. I must've missed the grant for the forwarder role. Checking key policy now.
eli: If the forwarder couldn't decrypt, it would skip forwarding those files. Those files still live in S3 encrypted under the new key. We can either (A) grant decrypt to forwarder role and re-run forwarder to pick up backlog, or (B) decrypt+re-encrypt in a one-off job and push to SIEM.
maria: Customer asked for ETA and wants raw logs meanwhile. They need evidence for compliance audit.
sam: Short-term: we can provide a signed S3 download link to the archived objects for that hour. Need to confirm we can decrypt for them (requires role access). Long-term: reprocess the hour through the forwarder.
security-bot: Note: retention policy for audit-archive is 365 days; objects are present unless lifecycle deleted.
jordan: I can add kms:Decrypt grant to the forwarder role `audit-forwarder-role` for key kr-0a9f3c2d. After that I'll trigger a re-run of the backlog job on forwarder-3. ETA ~30m.
maria: Can you also confirm schema compatibility? SIEM expects ECS-like fields, and some files in that batch were written by an older schema version (v0.9). Forwarder properly transforms to v1, but if forwarder failed mid-window some events might be v0.9 and will still be forwarded unchanged if we reprocess raw objects. SIEM mapping should accept both but we should confirm.
eli: Good catch — there was a small schema bump on 2026-02-09 that added `request.client_ip`. Forwarder properly transforms to v1, but if forwarder failed mid-window some events might be v0.9 and will still be forwarded unchanged if we reprocess raw objects. SIEM mapping should accept both but we should confirm.
sam: Action plan: 1) jordan adds KMS grant (kms:Decrypt) to forwarder role 2) ops re-run backlog job for C-827 3) provide signed S3 manifest to customer for immediate download 4) run a lightweight schema scan on the backlog objects to produce a compatibility report.
maria: I've opened support ticket S-6421 and notified the customer of temporary access to the S3 archive. They asked for a CSV of missing event IDs if possible.
jordan: Grant added at 1864123225Z. Forwarder role now has Decrypt on kr-0a9f3c2d.
ops-bot: Job queued: forwarder-backfill C-827 2026-02-10T03:00Z -> 2026-02-10T04:00Z (job id fb-8891).
eli: Starting schema scan on the S3 objects. Quick grep shows ~2% of objects use v0.9. I'll dump a small compatibility CSV: fields_missing.csv with event_id, key_diff.
sam: If SIEM ingestion still errors after re-run, we'll need to temporarily forward raw flattened JSON and let customer's mapper handle variations. Also add a regression alert to Redwood Optimize for future rotations.
maria: Customer acknowledged, appreciates the S3 link + ETA. Please copy me on the job completion.
security-bot: Compliance note: because this was due to missing grants during KMS rotation, create a post-rotation checklist item to validate forwarder grants + run smoke-forwarder test.
jordan: Backfill job completed at 1864123678Z. Forwarder reported 12,342 events forwarded, 0 decrypt errors.
eli: Uploaded compatibility report to S-6421 as fields_missing.csv (attached). Only 238 events were v0.9; I included example event_ids.
maria: Customer confirmed their SIEM now shows the missing hour and compliance team happy. Closing S-6421 after validation tomorrow. Thanks team :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-4278 auto-updated: resolved -> pending verification
sam: Follow-ups: add automated smoke test post-KMS-rotation that attempts decrypt+forward for a tiny test object per customer tier. I'll open a PR.
maria: Sounds good. Leaving this thread open until validation complete.
